column3: Alias "Plain Girl"
While on my way home on the next day...
...*sigh*
Are you all right, Kyou-chan? You've been sighing the entire time.
You're the only one that speaks so gently to me, Manami.
We're childhood friends, so it's normal for me to be worried about you.
--Normal.
That's the best description for this bespectacled childhood friend.
This person is called Tamura Manami.
As you can see, her appearance is very normal.
Although her face is pretty cute, she's a little plain.
She'd be a real beauty without her glasses! Or so I'd like to say but nope.
Her grades are decent. She doesn't takes part in any clubs; her interests are cooking and sewing.
Although her attitude makes her a lot of friends, the close ones that you'd hang out with after school decreased to the point of being not very many.
What's wrong? Why are you staring at my face?
I'm just thinking you're thoroughly ordinary.
Hehe, you're making me blush.
No, it's not something to be blushing about... *sigh*
Kyou-chan, why do you keep sighing today? Your happiness will run out, you know?
Yeah yeah... Oh, right, you mind listening to me for a while?
Of course, if you're fine with me.
I told the always-smiling, air-headed glasses girl about everything that happened yesterday.
Hmm hmm... I see.
So Kyou-chan is hesitating whether to go support Kirino at the tournament?
Exactly.
Ah, I do wish to support them, except Kirino.
Hehehe, is that so.
In any case, I do wish to give my support, but Kirino has been acting unsociable and angry since morning.
...Really?
It's true, why are you doubting me?
Really? Is Kirino-chan really angry?
She kicked me when we passed each other in the hallway!
Oh really. Then, I think she's not angry.
Huh?
This is "Manami", yet she's stating senseless things with a smug face.
Do you want to go support her?
...I'll consider it.
Okay.
